How it works

PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, email threads, Slack messages, scanned images — all formats are ingested, indexed, and made searchable. OCR automatically processes legacy documents.

Beyond text recognition, AI extracts meaning: decision context, stakeholders, timeline, rationale. Relationships across documents are discovered automatically.

Users ask natural language questions. AI searches across the entire knowledge base, synthesizes answers from multiple documents, and provides citations for every claim.

Stop losing institutional memory.

Enterprise Knowledge transforms organizational expertise into an AI-powered asset that never leaves.

The Trust Layer

Enterprise AI
you can trust.

Before adopting AI, enterprises need complete control. Control over what data is added. Control over who accesses information. Control over AI usage. Control over every action, every interaction, every outcome.

Control 1

Who can add knowledge?

Only authorized data stewards can introduce new information into your AI knowledge base.

Control 2

Who can access information?

Granular permissions ensure users see only the data their role permits.

Control 3

Who can use AI?

AI capabilities respond only to authorized users, with AI scope hardcoded to permissions.

Every action is governed and traceable

Immutable, timestamped audit logs record who did what, when, and whether the action was authorized.

Why does this matter?

Enterprise data lives in dozens of places — ERP, databases, cloud storage, paper. Without connection, this data remains siloed and unusable for AI insights.

Enterprise AI requires trust. Access controls, audit trails, and immutable records must be built into the data foundation from the start — not added later.

Many organizations abandon AI projects because they require replacing existing systems. Universal Data Intake connects what you have today, dramatically reducing cost and time to AI.
